observations: Vintage-style microwave oven with a cream-colored plastic casing.
The brand 'Russell Hobbs' is printed on the upper left of the glass door in photo 0.
A digital display is present on the right side of the door.
A control panel with buttons and a rotary dial is visible on the right.
The unit is shown installed in a white shelving unit.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ELECTRON WORLD' is overlaid on the image.

claims.evidence: The capacity is not clearly legible on the door in photo 0.

risks.risk: The microwave may not heat or power on.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit plugged in and the interior light or indicator light turning on.

risks.risk: The door seal or interior cavity may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the door gasket and the inside of the cavity.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged door seal

risks.risk: The internal heating element or magnetron may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the microwave operating and a thermometer inside showing a temperature rise.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's specification plate usually found on the back or inside.
Video of the microwave plugged in and operating.
Photo of the door gasket and the interior cavity.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
